Title: Dr. Martin Luthers Briefe, Sendschreiben und Bedenken, herausgegeben von Dr. Wilhelm Martin Leberecht de Wette; Vierter Theil: Luthers Briefe von seinem Aufenthalt auf der Koburger Veste wahrend des Reichstags zu Augsburg bis zur Schliessung der Wittenberger Concordie

Publisher: Berlin: bey G. Reimer (title page)
Publication Date: 1827 (title page, about OCR lines 25-62)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1827); the archive.org record carries the Public Domain Mark (licenseurl creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/), and the imprint date agrees
Language: lat; deu
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_fMoFAAAAQAAJ, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,340,784) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1827, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair to clean; the German black letter is fair to poor. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Luther's letters from April 1530 on, each with the editor's summary in German. The letters of 1530 begin at about OCR line 1206; those dated from the Coburg run through the following months (the place is named in some ninety lines); where the year 1530 ends was not pinned. The later years were not mapped.

Ia Ecclesia deest causa legum. 

Eficiens deest causa, quia nullus habet jus. 

Finals, quia omnia sunt jam praecepta et statuta, quae pia, 
licita, honesta et ad salutem necessaria sunt, nec est ullus 
alius finis. B 

‚Materialis deest, quia res et externa mundi bona non sunt 
Ecclesiae, sed spiritualia et aeterna. 

-Fermalis, quia melius et aptius nihil potest ordinari verbo 
Dei, quod in pondere, mensura, numero et ordine omnia 
Puit, ut fides, charitas, crux, decalogus, praecepta, 
promissiones. 

Ino ratio non capit causas formales, sicut neque materiales, 

neque efficientem (aut finalem) in Ecclesia. 

. Finalis causa legum in Ecclesia debet esse vita aeterna. 

: Materialis, peccatum et peccator justificandus, credens et 
Justitia coram Deo. 

. Eficiens, Dominus vitae aeternae. 

:Formalis causa est verbum vocale in spiritu doctum, con. 
ceptum, non tantum in charta aut voce signatum.

S; conscientia certa est, utramque speciem sacramenti 
Christi institutionem , quae hominibus non est in arbitri 
pro lubitu ac libere mutent: si utraque non permittat 
melius est in totum abstinere, quam contra conscient 
institutionem Christi mutata forma divinitus tradita una 
uti. Nam abstinere. in totum hic sine peccato fit, cum 
stet per nos, sed violenter nobis ab his, qui ministrare 
rapitur. Et hic simul ad tertiam quaestionem resp 
quod interim sufficit communicatio fidei seu spirituali, 
qua Augustinus: Crede ef manducasti, quia non licet c 
ralem manducationem pastoribus tyrannice rapere, aut vi 
torquere. Relinquitur ergo necesse spiritualis manducat 


Secundum cavendum, ne in privato aut secreto sac 
tum accipiatur, tum propter multa incommoda et peri 
tum maxime propter institutionem Christi , qui vult hoc 
mentum esse publicae confessionis dicens: Hoc facite in 
commemorationem, id est, praedicationem et annuntiati 
ut Paulus vocat. Rectius igitur in totum abstinetur. 


'T'ertio, !) si qui alibi utraque specie communicaverunt, } 
postea requisiti tenentur confiteri, quanquam non est ne 
si domi in tua parochia negetur, ut in aliena parochia d
